verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim is built on OpenUSD, an open scene format: it converts URDF, CAD, and real-world captures into USD. Its GitHub repo lists asset import and export of robots and environments to non-USD formats, and Isaac Lab can package policies into a portable deployment bundle. The evidence never shows a comprehensive 'export everything and leave' path, and it does not name the export targets or the output formats for synthetic data. missing for 10: documented export of all data types (synthetic datasets, trained policies, scenes) in named open formats, specifics on which non-USD export formats are supported, independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit path.
